summary: Deleted three unreferenced generated helpers from helpers.go.
reason: successfulNoop, paginatedGetWithResponsePath and handleBinaryResponseDelivery were emitted but never called anywhere in the module. handleBinaryResponseDelivery in particular implements dry-run and file-sink delivery semantics no caller reaches, so a maintainer reading it would believe the CLI has a delivery path it does not have.
validated_outcome: go build/vet clean, no import orphaned, dead_code 2/5 -> 5/5 on the bare scorecard.
